verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird offers one free startup-relevant document generator: the German Term Sheet Generator, built on Contract Express. It walks users through a questionnaire to produce a simplified term sheet for early German financing rounds and is stated to be "free to use." Beyond that, the only free resources are a non-startup SCC data-transfer generator and guidance or factsheet downloads (the TwoVenture hub and EMI factsheets), not actual forms. Missing for 10: incorporation document templates or generators, SAFE templates, NDA generators or forms, coverage beyond Germany, and independent or hands-on confirmation that non-clients can access the tool.
